purpose: Run one host-armed, synchronized 440 Hz direct-I2S diagnostic at a 4096 PCM peak without changing the reusable Doom audio backend.
runtime_blockers: The exact D2.4 firmware lifecycle passed, but synchronized microphone analysis found no qualifying 440 Hz event at peak PCM 4096.

A post-run cross-revision net audit showed GPIO30 also gates optional Q10 to the NS4168 CTRL pins; D2.4 held GPIO30 high and therefore likely disabled the candidate direct-amplifier path during its tone.
No operator was present for contemporaneous audibility or pop confirmation.
The one-shot authorization was consumed and revoked; another execution requires a new authorization record and ledger.
GPIO30 high shuts down U4 and turns optional Q10 off; a valid optional-direct-path test must request GPIO30 low only inside a zero-prime and zero-drain safety window.
Reusable platform audio, Doom audio, board-wide audio, app-only flash, and full-project flash remain unauthorized.
